source:
flowchart TD
    idle([Idle]) -->|connect| connecting[Connecting]
    connecting -->|ok| authenticating[Authenticating]
    connecting -->|timeout| backoff[Back off]
    backoff -->|retry| connecting
    backoff -->|give up| failed([Failed])
    authenticating -->|accepted| ready[Ready]
    authenticating -->|rejected| failed
    ready -->|request| busy[Busy]
    busy -->|done| ready
    busy -->|error| recovering[Recovering]
    recovering -->|recovered| ready
    recovering -->|fatal| failed
    ready -->|idle timeout| closing[Closing]
    closing --> idle
    failed -->|reset| idle
